answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the dawn graph and each risks its bond. Because the yarrow release is recorded with every signature, the spiral audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 3 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 36 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
